constraints.source_text: Admission to Thornton programs is granted through the USC admission process. Applicants are screened by appropriate faculty selection committees.
constraints.description: Admission requires screening by faculty selection committees as part of the USC admission process.

constraints.source_text: Eight courses are required in six Core Literacies, in addition to two courses in Global Perspectives, two courses in Writing, and one General Education Seminar taken during the first year at USC.
constraints.description: Students must complete eight courses across six Core Literacies GE categories.

GE-H: Global Perspectives II (one course)

constraints.source_text: A capstone project must be completed under approved faculty supervision and guidance. The faculty of the department of the student’s major program determines the detailed requirements of the project, including content, length, format and other specifications.
constraints.description: The capstone project's requirements are determined and supervised by department faculty.
constraints.note: No enumerated content requirements are given, so this cannot be verified from a course list.

constraints.source_text: In cases in which a performance venue is required in order to present the project, reservations must be made according to the current guidelines of the Music Operations office.
constraints.description: Students needing a performance venue for their capstone must follow Music Operations office reservation guidelines.
constraints.note: Procedural note about venue reservation; closest fit is PROCEDURAL though it is not advising specifically.

unclassified.source_text: Specific entrance requirements are reviewed on an annual basis and published online at music.usc.edu.
unclassified.why: This is an informational/administrative statement about publication of requirements, not itself a binding student requirement.

unclassified.source_text: With careful planning, certain courses (including courses required for the music major) can fulfill more than one of these general education requirements.

unclassified.source_text: This typically will result in Thornton students taking a total of eight courses (including two writing courses) in order to fulfill all of the USC general education requirements.
unclassified.why: Advisory/descriptive statement about typical outcomes, not a binding requirement.

unclassified.source_text: [*]With correct planning, only 32 units (six GE and two writing courses) will be needed outside of your major requirements.
